output.content: I open the Grafana dashboard for the production inference cluster at 09:00 each morning. I scan the latency percentiles and error rates for the previous twenty-four hours. When a value crosses the red threshold line, I copy the timestamp into the shared spreadsheet. I then send a message to the on-call engineer in the team chat with the link to the dashboard. I wait for their reply before we decide on any model version rollback. The manual scan takes about fifteen minutes to complete. I perform this check once per day during the standard work shift.
